_instructions: Hand-maintained. Survives re-running `pnpm analyze:series`, unlike the
generated sermon-series-map.json which is overwritten each time.
map: postSlug -> series id, existing series title, or null to leave unset.
A title that does not exist yet will be created under that name.
titles: postSlug -> the name a NEW series should be given, when the post
title is not what you want the series called.

titles._comment_duplicates: Three series names were reused years apart. Payload shows series by title alone, so identical names are unusable in the admin. Year suffixes are a suggestion — rename freely, they just have to differ.
